description: This file is a shell script used for platform-specific upgrade procedures within an OpenWRT build environment. It defines functions to check the image and perform the upgrade, and customizes the upgrade process based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to check if the provided image is valid; currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade by invoking default upgrade procedures or specific board upgrade functions.
